chapter: Follow-up questions, Bird and the Ellington sidemen
title: Al Sully and John Sully, Duke's road managers
summary: Willard and Jones talk about Al Sully and his brother John, who had died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Did you know Al Sully, Duke's road manager?
They used to have a lot of funny things the guys in the band would do with Hibbler and Al Sully, because they used to send Hibbler out to help Sully.
Yeah, it was Al and his brother John.
Yeah. I think Al is still around Philadelphia. John passed away a year or two years ago.
Yeah, he was living in Las Vegas and I think it was -- Louis Bellson told me. It was about two or three years ago.
Oh, I didn't know he'd passed.
